meta.name: memory-search
meta.description: Search conversation history and semantic memory to recall previous discussions, decisions, and context. Use when the user asks to "search memory", "what did we discuss", "remember when", "find previous conversation", "check history", or before starting work to recall prior decisions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索对话历史与语义记忆，快速找回之前讨论和决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要回顾之前的对话或决策
copy.tagline_en: Search conversation history and semantic memory to recall past discussions and decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to recall previous conversations or decisions

howto.what: 当您要求Claude做任何任务时，它会先搜索对话历史与语义记忆，找回之前的讨论、决策和上下文，然后再开始工作。
howto.when: 当您明确要求搜索记忆、询问之前讨论的内容，或者当Claude准备开始一项新任务时，它会自动触发记忆搜索。

say.text: 搜索记忆：我们之前讨论过什么？
say.note: Claude会检索对话历史中的相关内容。

say.text: 查找之前的对话：关于登录功能的讨论
say.note: Claude会搜索与“登录”相关的历史。

say.text: 检查历史：回忆一下之前的决策
say.note: Claude会搜索记忆并总结之前的决策。

howto.what_en: When you ask Claude to do any task, it will first search conversation history and semantic memory to recall previous discussions, decisions, and context before proceeding.
howto.when_en: When you explicitly ask to search memory, inquire about past discussions, or when Claude is about to start a new task, it will automatically trigger memory search.

say_en.text: Search memory: what did we discuss?
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve relevant content from history.

say_en.text: Find previous conversation: talk about login feature
say_en.note: Claude will search for 'login' related history.
Claude will search memory and summarize past decisions.
